function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議您參考以下幾個可靠來源：

| 平台 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 提供即時行情、新聞與分析 |
| Reuters | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities | 具備全球商品價格更新 |
| Kitco | https://www.kitco.com/ | 專門報導黃金、白銀等貴金屬價格 |
| Investing.com | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 提供圖表、歷史數據與即時報價 |

您也可以直接在手機或電腦的金融新聞 App（如 CNBC、Yahoo Finance）搜尋「Gold」或「黃金」來查看最新價格。祝您投資順利！
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). They want the current price. We don't have real-time data. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, or market data. We can provide typical range or approximate. But we should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites.
